segments: the Romans who were in his domain.
And when Nicephorus agreed to peace,
Harun gave him even the tents in which he had sat, and their furnishings.
And in the same year, Harun built a city above Callinicus and called it Heraclea,
after the name of the woman whom he had taken from the house of the Heraclians.
And Nicephorus also, being alarmed by the Arabs,
built Ancyra and other places in place of Tyana and Heraclea, which the Arabs had taken in his time.
And in the year 1119
(1119 of the Greeks,
808 of our Lord), famine grew fierce, even among wild beasts {literally: beasts of the tooth};
and they were digging up the dead from the graves and eating them,
and they were attacking the living.
And women and children who went out to eat grass,
were eaten by the beasts.
Now Harun, wishing to go down to Persia against a certain rebel,
made his son Muhammad reign in Baghdad,
and Qasim, another son, in Syria.
And he took al-Ma'mun with him down to Khorasan,
and instead of kingship, he bestowed upon him a thousand tens of thousands (ten million) of silver.
And when that Harun reached the city of Tus (Mashhad?),
and killed the rebel,
he died there in the year 1120
And at this time, Bukhtisho bar George, the Elamite (of Beth Huzaye/Jundishapur) physician, became famous.
And when the Caliph Harun al-Rashid fell ill,
he sent and brought him from Elam.
And when he entered,
he blessed the king in Persian and in Arabic.
And the king smiled,
and summoned the rest of the physicians to debate with him.
And 'Isa Abu Quraysh the physician said:
"My lord king,
have mercy on us;
there is none among us who can speak with this man,
because he is a jar that is full,
and he and his father and his family are philosophers."
And the Caliph secretly commanded one of the eunuchs to bring the urine of a certain beast, so that he might test Bukhtisho with it,
to see whether he could distinguish it or not.
And when he brought it and he looked at it, he said:
"This is not the urine of a human being."
And Quraysh the physician contended against him and said:
"You lie;
it is the urine of one of the king's concubines."
And Bukhtisho became bold,
and said to him:
"I say to you,
O honored elder,
never has a human being urinated like this!
Look at the color, the consistency, and the smell, if you have understanding."
And he said to him:
"What should the one whose water this is eat?" And Bukhtisho replied:
"Barley."
